conviction_note: Q3 is new (only unit sales are out) but the 1 Oct pre-close call talked expectations down and no MAR ad-hoc has followed, though Traton files one when a quarter misses or beats consensus significantly (Q3 2024, Q2 2026, FY25 cash). So the operating line probably lands near the bar, and the move rests on Q3 order intake and the confirmed guide. Peers (Volvo orders +26%, trucks margin 11.1% vs 9.1%; International units +48%) lean positive on a stock that has de-rated 20% in 60 days. The VW stake-sale overhang and a guide reiterated four weeks ago keep p_up near 56. The findings sum to +1.1 and the scaled number is +0.6 (5.0 abs x 0.12); they agree in sign, and the scaled number is smaller because most of the evidence is proxy.

positioning_check: Bundesanzeiger Netto-Leerverkaufspositionen register read as of 2026-10-26: no disclosed net short position at or above 0.5%. anchor_covered is false, so this is the truncation floor and not a measurement, and the change is unknown. Free float is only about 12.5% (VW holds 87.5% after the March 2025 ABB). The live positioning factor is VW's stated plan to sell down to 75%+1 share (Bloomberg/Levin interview, Aug-Sep 2026), which is supply overhang rather than a short.

findings.finding: Q3 order intake is new in the release and the counterparty evidence points strong. Volvo's Q3 2026 report (23 Oct) shows net truck orders 46,918 vs 37,134 (+26%) and a trucks adj. margin of 11.1% vs 9.1% with positive price realization. Traton's own pre-close says NA 2027 order books opened in Aug/Sep with Oct/Nov the key fleet ordering months, Scania orders improved clearly in the second half of September, and IAA orders support MAN's Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the H1 release (23 Jul 2026) incoming orders +30% and a narrowed-up guide drove +11.02%, although the Q2 operating result had been pre-released by ad-hoc 10 days earlier (+0.69% on that ad-hoc).
findings.why_not_priced: Traton never pre-releases orders, only units. If the market had priced a strong order line, the stock would not have drifted -1.3% on Volvo's results day and -6.9% over 20 days with no company-specific negative. It sits at 32.6 against 41.3 at the August high.
findings.independence: Traton Q3 2026 pre-close slide 3-4 (company's own order commentary): https://www.eqs-news.com/media/document/bc05f21f-6283-4f3a-9aea-c351dcb93ac2/assets/261001_TRATON_Pre-Close_Call_Presentation_Q3_2026_final.pdf; Daimler Truck Q3 2026 NA units 45,629 vs 30,225: https://mbpassion.de/2026/10/daimler-truck-absatz-steigt-im-3-quartal-2026-um-26/

findings.finding: No ad-hoc on the Q3 operating result. Traton files a MAR Article 17 ad-hoc when a quarter deviates significantly from consensus (Q3 2024 above, Q2 2026 at 957 vs 763 consensus, FY2025 NCF), and EQS shows no ad-hoc since 13 Jul 2026, so Q3 adj. operating profit most likely lands within roughly 10% of the company-compiled consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Quarters without an ad-hoc moved modestly on results day: Q3 2025 (29 Oct 2025) +2.75%, Q1 2026 (29 Apr 2026) +1.30%, FY2025 (4 Mar 2026) -3.17%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is not a mispricing. It is why the reported-quarter line is sized at zero: the company's disclosure practice makes a large operating surprise unlikely. The open risk is a beat of under 10% that the company did not judge price-sensitive.
findings.independence: Q3 2024 precedent, ad-hoc 'Preliminary operating result for Q3 2024 above market expectations': https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/eqs/traton-se--0aa4/eqs-adhoc-traton-se-preliminary-operating-r-/8499598

findings.finding: The 1 Oct pre-close call flagged Q3 negatives that will appear in the print: MAN Q3 margin headwinds from lower German volumes, seasonally softer Q3 at MAN and Scania, International supplier-ramp logistics costs, VWTB margin under a revised dealer-floorplan accounting treatment, a low triple-digit-million input-cost burden plus energy costs, and Operations net cash inflow concentrated in Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 1.88% on the pre-close day (1 Oct 2026), and Exane BNP cut its target from 47 to 41 on 6 Oct. Q2 2026 NCF missed (-18m vs 283m consensus) and the stock still rose on the results day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Pre-close calls exist to move consensus, and the target cuts that followed show estimates moved. What is left is the size of the VWTB accounting change and the Q3 cash figure, which the slides did not quantify.
findings.independence: Exane BNP target cut 47 to 41 on 6 Oct 2026: https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/traton-aktie-exane-bnp-senkt-kursziel-halt-aber-an-outperform-fest

findings.finding: FY2026 guidance was narrowed to the upper end in July and reiterated on 1 Oct. With 9M units +3% and the main International acceleration still to come in Q4, confirmation is the base case, with a small chance of narrowing the RoS range upward.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Narrowing to the upper end on 23 Jul 2026 came with +11.02% (alongside orders). The 2025 guidance cut came with a weak tape (Q2 2025 window -4.87%).
findings.why_not_priced: The reiteration is priced. The small positive is the option of a narrowing that the strong US volume (International +48%) and peer margins make plausible. The market has not paid for it, judging by a stock 21% off its August high.

findings.finding: IEEPA tariff refunds: Q2 already booked non-cash refund receivables at International (the source of the Q2 beat). The pre-close says Traton remains engaged in the customs process and expects the refunds in Q4 cash flow, so further receivables could be recognised in Q3 as a one-off.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 refund-driven beat was pre-released by ad-hoc and the stock rose only 0.69% on it. The rally came two weeks later on orders and guidance.
findings.why_not_priced: Any Q3 recognition is not quantified anywhere public. It is a one-off with no path to the guide beyond cash, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: CBP IEEPA refund process live since 20 Apr 2026: https://spidell.com/news/flash-email/2026-15-customs-border-patrol-to-start-processing-ieepa-tariff-refunds-on-april-20/

outside_window.finding: VW intends to cut its 87.5% stake to 75%+1 share (CEO Levin via Bloomberg, reported 17 Aug / 3 Sep 2026). The only precedent ABB was launched right after the FY2024 results and priced at an 8% discount, with a 7.5% intraday fall the next day. A post-results ABB would be launched after the 28 Oct close and hit the following session.
Section 232 US-content recognition for International's Mexican-built trucks: the company 'could have a decision by year-end'.
Daimler Truck full Q3 2026 results (NA units +51%) on 6 Nov, a peer read-through after the window.

baseline_tension: Mild agreement. priced_lean_pct is +0.35, entirely the run-up term on a -6.9% 20-day and -20% 60-day drift, and the findings lean the same small positive. Since the lean is just the free control, agreeing with it is not an edge, and p_up stays at 56.
language_note: The issuer publishes every release, ad-hoc and pre-close deck in English through EQS, identical to the German versions, so the primary documents carried nothing language-specific.

German press (Börsen-Zeitung, 19 Mar 2025) carried the detail on the only VW placement: an 8% discount to the Xetra close, a 7.5% intraday fall and a 90-day lock-up. That is the template for the stake-sale overhang now in outside_window. The English results found here did not give the discount.
German retail wires (goldesel.de) were the only dated source found for the October 2026 sell-side action (Exane BNP 47 to 41 on 6 Oct) and for the 3 Sep reaction to the 75% stake plan.
lessons_applied: 'A beat made of a one-off is sold' (H&M tariff refund): the IEEPA refund finding goes from +0.3 to +0.2

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-close negatives go from -0.5 to -0.4, and the Q3 cash softness the company already flagged is folded into that finding rather than filed alone (Luceco cash lesson noted, but the company told the market)

'Too small about the move' and 'size the move on what is new': abs_move_pct goes from 4.5 to 5.0 because Q3 numbers and orders are new while the guide is likely reiterated; expected_move goes from +0.54 to +0.60
'A German ad-hoc before the print may have pre-released the number': checked, none filed, so the Q3 line stays new; nothing changed
